F1.threshold_text: theta < 0.183 cm3 cm-3 in 0-1 m soil depth, derived with FAO criterion from thetaFC = 0.26 and thetaWP = 0.12.
F1.note: Not calculated: 0.183 m3/m3 was derived for one soil from local field capacity and wilting point. A global ERA5-Land comparison is not scientifically transferable without pixel-level soil calibration.

F2.threshold_text: Precipitation accumulated over a rolling 10-day window <30 mm during the reproductive phase in grain maize.
F2.note: Provisional regional trigger from Bavaria (1983-2021). The calculator now evaluates rolling 10-day precipitation, never daily precipitation <30 mm. Recalibration is required before global risk interpretation.

F3.threshold_text: Mean Tmax of 39.4-41.5 deg C for 7 days during effective grain filling caused clear damage.
F3.evidence_type: Experimental damaging treatment, not an onset threshold
F3.source: Zhang et al., 2023; Mu et al., 2025
F3.note: Not calculated: 39.4-41.5 deg C is a seven-day treatment that caused damage; the study did not estimate the critical onset. At 32.9 deg C no significant effect was detected, leaving an unresolved interval.

F1.threshold_text: -0.046 to -0.056 MPa threshold for soil/solution water potential.

F2.evidence_type: Declared anthesis threshold with experimental support

F3.threshold_text: Published critical temperatures near 25-27.3 deg C refer to specific chalkiness types and the Sai-no-kagayaki cultivar over 30 days after heading; they are not a universal yield threshold.
F3.source: Masutomi et al., 2015; Liu et al., 2021
F3.note: Not calculated until a globally appropriate outcome and cultivar scope are defined. The previous >25 deg C for 3 daily observations was not supported by the cited sources.

F1.threshold_text: Germination follows a continuous response with an optimum near 20.5 deg C and declines above and below it; no validated binary daily-air-Tmax trigger was identified.
F1.evidence_type: Continuous germination response, not a binary air-temperature threshold
F1.source: Kanapickas et al., 2024; Soureshjani et al., 2026
F1.note: Not calculated: the previous >30 deg C for 3 days mixed constant seed-germination temperature with daily air Tmax and omitted cold stress.

F2.threshold_text: Critical maximum temperature for grain set at anthesis was fitted at 31.7 deg C under irrigation and 29.9 deg C without irrigation; 30 deg C is used as a provisional midpoint trigger.
F2.note: Provisional trigger: sensitivity depends on water status and the F2 calendar is broader than anthesis. Interpret as historical trigger frequency, not probability of yield loss.
